csv_project_name: Design for Blaine multimodal & Peace Portal Community Trail
csv_scope_of_work: The city is seeking qualifications from the consultants to provide professional services for the following projects:Project #1 Blaine multimodal improvements. This project will eliminate the sidewalk gap along SR 548 Peace Portal Drive from Clark Street to Boblett Street by constructing 161 linear feet of ADA-compliant, 8-foot-wide concrete sidewalk to fill the gap and will upgrade the ADA ramps at the mid-block crossing to complete the continuous walking and rolling route along and across SR 548 in downtown Blaine. and will install five flashing crosswalks at five intersections surrounding the central campus for all Blaine schools. Project #2 Blaine Peace Portal Community Trail Hughes Avenue to Bell Road. Phase 3 of the Peace Portal Community Trail will extend the paved 10-foot-wide multiuse pathway 1,800 linear feet to the southeast to the City of Blaine welcome sign at the intersection of Bell Road and Peace Portal.
csv_disciplines_requested: Landscape Architecture, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Traffic Design Engineering
